coverage: 25 first-level divisions: 24 provinces and Phnom Penh capital. Current English/Khmer names and administrative codes checked against the NCDD gazetteer; 2024 NIS/UNFPA population projections. Polygon reference is OCHA 2018, reviewed October 2024. Older district boundaries are omitted because the gazetteer now lists 210 district-level units while the polygon snapshot has 197. Tonle Sap and mapped inland lakes are excluded from fills. Shared frontiers follow the existing Thailand, Laos and Vietnam atlas geometry.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
